hook_text: I'm Aunty Grace. Your spaza shop already does double-entry bookkeeping. Let me show you where.
clip_script:
Hello there, my child! I'm Aunty Grace. Your spaza shop already does double-entry bookkeeping, even if you don't know it yet. Let me show you where.

When a customer buys a loaf of bread, they hand me money. That money goes into my tin. But here's the secret: not all that money belongs to me. A little piece belongs to SARS—the tax man. 

A lot of learners make a mistake here. If a bag of maize meal is R2 875 including VAT, they just calculate 15% of that. No! That inclusive amount is 115%. My original price was 100%, and I added 15% VAT on top.

To find the VAT, use the formula: what we WANT over what we HAVE. We want the 15%, and we have the 115%. Multiply your total by 15 over 115. That’s how you find the tax man’s slice!
visual_style: Warm, spaza shop setting transitioning into simple whiteboard math with bright highlight colors for 115%.
pacing: Patient but rhythmic, emphasizing the formula.
